# Green Core Heating & Air

> Locally owned residential HVAC and water heater contractor based in Petaluma, California, serving homeowners in Sonoma and Marin counties. Specialists in heat pumps, heat pump water heaters, and Harvest Thermal whole-home systems, with a design-first approach and help claiming rebates.

- Business name: Green Core Heating & Air (Green Core)
- Phone: (707) 988-5858
- Email: hello@greencorehvac.com
- Address: 1600 Corporate Circle, Petaluma, CA 94954 (service-area business; we come to you)
- License: California CSLB #1131183
- Hours: Monday-Friday 7am-6pm, Saturday 8am-4pm
- Recognition: Best of the North Bay 2026
- Free in-home estimates for installation and replacement projects

## Services

- [Repair](https://www.greencorehvac.com/hvac-repair): repairs for heat pumps, AC, furnaces, mini splits, ductwork, Harvest Thermal, and all water heater types
- [Installation and replacement](https://www.greencorehvac.com/hvac-installation): free in-home estimates; permits and rebate paperwork handled
- [Maintenance and tune-ups](https://www.greencorehvac.com/hvac-maintenance): heat pump, AC, furnace, mini split, and water heater maintenance
- [Heat pumps](https://www.greencorehvac.com/services/heat-pumps): installation, repair, and replacement of ducted heat pump systems
- [Harvest Thermal](https://www.greencorehvac.com/services/harvest-thermal): integrated heat pump system for heating, hot water, and cooling with smart controls
- [Ductless mini splits](https://www.greencorehvac.com/services/mini-splits): zoned heating and cooling for additions, ADUs, garages, and older homes
- [Air conditioning](https://www.greencorehvac.com/services/air-conditioning): installation, repair, and replacement
- [Furnaces](https://www.greencorehvac.com/services/furnaces): installation, repair, and replacement
- [Ductwork](https://www.greencorehvac.com/services/duct-work): design, repair, and replacement
- [Water heaters](https://www.greencorehvac.com/services/water-heaters): installation, repair, and replacement; gas and electric tank installs start at $2,850; same-day replacement when the schedule allows
  - [Heat pump water heaters](https://www.greencorehvac.com/services/heat-pump-water-heaters): SANCO2 and GE GeoSpring
  - [Tankless water heaters](https://www.greencorehvac.com/services/tankless-water-heaters): Navien
  - [Gas water heaters](https://www.greencorehvac.com/services/gas-water-heaters): Bradford White and American Standard
  - [Electric water heaters](https://www.greencorehvac.com/services/electric-water-heaters): Bradford White and American Standard
- Not offered: in-floor radiant or hydronic systems

## Rebates

Green Core is a participating contractor with TECH Clean California, BayREN, Sonoma Clean Power, and MCE programs, and handles rebate paperwork for customers. The federal 25C tax credit ended for systems installed after December 31, 2025.

## Service areas

Sonoma County: [Petaluma](https://www.greencorehvac.com/service-areas/petaluma), [Rohnert Park](https://www.greencorehvac.com/service-areas/rohnert-park), [Santa Rosa](https://www.greencorehvac.com/service-areas/santa-rosa), [Cotati](https://www.greencorehvac.com/service-areas/cotati), [Sebastopol](https://www.greencorehvac.com/service-areas/sebastopol), [Windsor](https://www.greencorehvac.com/service-areas/windsor), [Sonoma](https://www.greencorehvac.com/service-areas/sonoma)

Marin County: [Novato](https://www.greencorehvac.com/service-areas/novato), [San Rafael](https://www.greencorehvac.com/service-areas/san-rafael), [Mill Valley](https://www.greencorehvac.com/service-areas/mill-valley), [Tiburon](https://www.greencorehvac.com/service-areas/tiburon), [San Anselmo](https://www.greencorehvac.com/service-areas/san-anselmo), [Fairfax](https://www.greencorehvac.com/service-areas/fairfax)
